evidence_items.publisher: NVIDIA remarks transcribed by FactSet CallStreet; hosted by MediaNama

evidence_items.explanation: Huang asserts improved intelligence with more compute and subsequently describes computational requirements as exponential. The passage supplies neither an AGI demonstration nor an explicit quantified equivalence between exponential costs and benefits.

unresolved_gaps: The transcript does not settle whether the alleged conflation means an explicit assertion or an implied sales argument.
No defined benefit measure permits testing the alleged exponential equivalence.
The narrower observation that these remarks do not establish AGI does not settle the accompanying attribution.
